column1: # Calls written by hand, merged into triggers.fmtrig by the bake.
# The generated pack only covers what its source covers. Where a fight's later
# phases were never written up there, the call is put in here instead, so a
# re-bake adds to these rather than wiping them.
# Wording is copied word for word from where the call came from. Nothing here
# is reworded, shortened or made friendlier: a call people already know has to
# read the way they know it.
# Only calls the engine can fire exactly go in. A call that needs to know which
# tower this is, who was hit last, or where a cast landed does not belong here
# until a fight module tracks that; a row on the id alone would fire on every
# other one of them too.
# duty   key   kind   id(hex)   source   target   severity   text
#   kind      cast | ability | gains | loses
#   source    anyone | me | notme | enemy | player | other | untargeted
#   target    the same
#   severity  info | warn | danger
# ---- Dancing Mad (Ultimate), phase 4 ----
# Only the opening cast: the rest of this phase reads head markers and the
# real-or-fake VFX on the boss, and neither is wired up yet.
# ---- Dancing Mad (Ultimate), phase 5 ----
